subject: Cerulean Service Hub — provisioning for 4 new projects & term alignment
messages:
From: Julia Hayes <julia.hayes@ceruleanhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: mx-team@ceruleanhealth.com
Date: Thu, 11 May 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick question — adding new projects to Service Hub

Hi Priya,

Hope you’re well. We’re planning to onboard four additional microservices teams into the Cerulean Service Hub this summer (billing/legal calls it Project group: ServiceMesh). The teams will need separate API keys (one per service) and isolated quotas. High level:
- 4 new project workspaces (auth, telemetry, alerting, ingestion)
- Expected 3.5M tokens / month aggregate, spiking to ~6M during load tests
- Need term alignment with our upcoming Q4 renewal (we'd prefer the same contract period)

Can Redwood provision the keys and a single addendum to tie the projects to the existing account/term? Also please send an estimate of incremental monthly cost and any SLA impact.

Attaching our internal sketch of the rollout (will share MAP if helpful).

Thanks,
Julia
Julia Hayes
Director of Platform Engineering
Cerulean Health

Attachment: Cerulean_rollout_sketch.png (image stub)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Julia Hayes <julia.hayes@ceruleanhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 May 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick question — adding new projects to Service Hub

Hi Julia — great to hear from you. This is doable and we can align the new projects to your existing renewal so you’re not on a mismatched term. Next steps I propose:

1) Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — I’ll send a MAP today outlining deliverables, dates, and owners.
2) Provisioning details — we’ll create 4 project namespaces with isolated API keys and quota profiles.
3) Capacity & pricing — Ben will confirm incremental cost and how bursting is handled during the load tests.
4) Legal addendum — I’ll loop in Kimberly for a short addendum that ties the projects to CH-4821 and matches the Q4 term.
5) Onboarding runbook — Monica will coordinate a 2-hour onboarding session and key handoff the week of May 22.

We’ll attach the DocuSign addendum to the MAP and aim for keys to be ready by May 24 if we sign by May 19. Is that timeline ok on your side?

I’ve attached a first-pass MAP.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Cerulean_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Julia Hayes <julia.hayes@ceruleanhealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 May 2028 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick question — adding new projects to Service Hub

Hi all — quick pricing note so expectations are clear:
- Base incremental: $0.0009 / token for standard hosted tier (applies to new projects if they stay on hosted API)
- Volume tiers: above 5M tokens/mo aggregate we tier to $0.0007 / token (we’ll reflect that in the MAP)
- Bursting beyond provisioned quota: temporary burst is allowed up to 2x for 72 hours; persistent burst requires reserved capacity onboarding (separate scope)

Estimate for the expected steady state (3.5M tokens): ~$3,150/mo incremental. Under spike (6M) the billing for overage would show at the tiered rate for the excess once aggregate thresholds are reached.

If you’d like firm committed pricing for Q4 we can add a reserved capacity line item to the addendum.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Thanks Ben / Priya — that pricing is helpful. Two quick clarifications from our side:
1) For the spike during load tests we’d prefer not to incur unexpected charges — can Redwood temporarily elevate quota for the test window and bill at the tiered rate only?
2) Legal: we need an addendum (no change to base SLA) that references CH-4821 and adds the 4 projects/list of project names. Kimberly, could you confirm acceptable language?

I’m available next week for a 30-minute call to confirm dates.

Julia

Julia / team — I’ve reviewed and proposed language for a minimal addendum: it references the master subscription (CH-4821), lists the 4 new project namespaces, and confirms no change to base SLA or data handling terms. Key points:
